            for (int diff_idx = 0; diff_idx < strLen && diff_idx < length; ++diff_idx) {

                    for (int i = 0; i < current_prefix.length(); ++i) {

                    long count_smallers = 0;
                    StringBuilder temp_str = new StringBuilder();
                    for (int pos = 0; pos < current_prefix.length(); ++pos) {
                        for (char d = (pos == 0 ? '1' : '0'); d < current_prefix.charAt(pos); ++d) {
                            String s2 = temp_str.toString() + d;
                            long v = 0;
                            for (int chIdx = 0; chIdx < s2.length(); ++chIdx) {
                                v = v * 10 + (s2.charAt(chIdx) - '0');
                            }
                            count_smallers += pow10[s2.length()] - v * pow10[s2.length() - 1];

                    for (Long v : vars) {
                        res += (prefix_sum_value + v) % 998244353;
                    }
                    total += res % 998244353;

        System.out.println(Long.toString(total % 1000000007));
